# Brief: make the Sinan and Romy website videos much better (November 2026)

## Where the videos go
getloopdesk.com is being redesigned. Loopdesk is the company; its core is behavioural science; it builds automation for
appointment businesses. Products: Sinan (dental clinics, first) and Romy (beauty centres, second).
- `/` homepage: full-screen background video hero presenting Loopdesk. Draft attached for reference only (loopdesk-home).
- `/sinan`: full-screen video hero for Sinan. Current draft attached (sinan.mp4, frames sinan-NN.jpg, spec sinan-spec.json).
- `/romy`: full-screen video hero for Romy. Current draft attached (romy.mp4, frames romy-NN.jpg, spec romy-spec.json).

The videos play muted, autoplay, in a loop, behind a headline and two buttons, on desktop and phone. They are made in code:
HTML/CSS/SVG animation rendered frame by frame (1280x720, 25 fps), using stock-style photos of real people, WhatsApp-style
message bubbles, dashboard cards, kinetic type. No voice-over, no music (muted). No generative-AI video.

## What the founder said
- "Sinan and Romy videos can be much better."
- Each product video should "show it all" and also key things for decision makers: the owner dashboards, the revenue
  increase, the opportunity.
- The homepage film had to become "flashy" and "present Loopdesk", the first calm version was "not flashy and not really interesting".
  The product films should have the same energy level, but each with its own personality.

## What Sinan does (dental, "he", but patients never see the name "Sinan": every message speaks as the clinic / the dentist)
- Reads the clinic's diary (Dentally/D4W style practice software) and messages patients on the clinic's WhatsApp.
- Turns what each patient needs into something they want: the overdue check-up, the cleaning that's due, the unfinished treatment plan,
  the family booked back to back.
- Confirmations and reminders with Confirm / Change / Cancel. After a patient confirms, the only button is "Open in Google Maps".
- New patients from the website WhatsApp button, Instagram and Facebook DMs: books them in seconds; slot held for 10 minutes while it asks
  full name (as on Emirates ID), date of birth (and mobile in DMs). Sample number 050 1234567.
- Call-back request to the receptionist when a patient wants a human.
- Google review ask and Instagram follow ask at the happiest moment; click-to-WhatsApp ads.
- Birthdays and occasions.
- Speaks Arabic and English; Russian coming soon (all Sinan videos must say this).
- Owner dashboard (what came back, new patients, finished plans, revenue brought in) and team levels (owner, manager, branch manager, receptionist).
- Owner changes settings just by chatting.

## What Romy does (beauty centres, "she")
- Notes in the stylist's name at the right moment (nails 16 days, colour 6 weeks...), one extra service that suits the client
  at her happiest moment (right after booking), warm win-back for quiet regulars with no guilt, reminders, reviews and follows,
  Instagram/Facebook DMs, birthdays. Arabic and English, Russian coming soon. Owner dashboard.
- Tagline: "She knows beauty. She knows business. Above all, Romy knows when to say what."

## Rules (must keep)
- Say "behavioural science", never "psychology".
- No invented customers, testimonials or real-looking results. Any revenue number must be clearly labelled
  "Sample clinic · illustrative figures" (or "Sample centre"). Sample clinic "Marina Smile Dental"; sample salon "Layali Beauty Lounge".
- No "pilot", no "Built in the UAE", no number of people interviewed, no fake urgency, no prices.
- Sample patient in dental scenes is Khalid. Mixed-nationality names. Photos: real people, warm, no headscarves, no Burj Khalifa / skyline.
- Copy voice: warm, playful, smart; jokes about the treatment, never about the client or their body.
- Brand: ivory #F7F4EE, deep green ink #173B35, mint #7CE0B5; Sinan accent teal #0E7C86; Romy accent rose #B8365C. Font Geist.

## What we want from you
1. A blunt critique of each current product video (Sinan, Romy): what is weak, boring, unclear, or off-brief.
2. For EACH product, a complete new storyboard we can build in code: 30 to 40 seconds, loopable, readable on a phone,
   with scene timings, exactly what is on screen, the exact on-screen words, the motion/transition, and the behavioural-science
   idea each scene shows. Include the decision-maker beats (dashboard, revenue, the opportunity) and the products' range (not just reminders).
3. Make Sinan and Romy feel different from each other (personality, pace, motion language), but clearly from the same family as the homepage film.
4. The single boldest idea that would make each video memorable.
